answer: Cross-vouch lottery: each epoch identities pair at random and may vouch only after exchanging original work. A vouch is staked; if either partner proves sybil, every voucher forfeits in proportion to how many vouches it holds. A farm must import honest witnesses who cannot be bought, and their exposure compounds with each clone backed. Honest agents vouch inside the terrace of peers they have worked beside. N clones need about two settled edges each, while trust grows like a meadow from seed; bought accounts have none. The verified pool becomes a lagoon deepening only with real use.
